name: Mitsubishi MU-2
summary: Fast Japanese twin turboprop with a short wing, cigar fuselage and full-span flaps, widely used for air freight and charter.

wings: Short, thick high wing mounted on top of the fuselage
Large cylindrical tip tanks on most examples
Big flaps spanning most of the trailing edge
engines: Two Garrett turboprops in short, slim nacelles ahead of the wing
fuselage: Small windows and a pointed nose
tail: Conventional tail with a swept fin

tellTales: Cylindrical tip tanks on short stubby wings
Long thin tube fuselage with small windows
Short engine nacelles mounted ahead of the wing

confusedWith.howToTell: Both are high-wing twins, but the Commander has a boxier cabin, long nacelles and no tip tanks; the MU-2 has a slim cigar-tube body, short nacelles and cylindrical tip tanks.
The Conquest has a low-mounted wing with long nacelles and no tip tanks; the MU-2 has a short high wing with cylindrical tip tanks.
The King Air has a low wing with big nacelles and larger cabin windows; the MU-2 has a short high wing, tip tanks and small windows.
